capabilities.title: Work Tasks End in Purchases. WorkBuddy Can Finish Them.
capabilities.body: Replacing a keyboard, settling a one-off fee, buying event supplies—these are the steps where tasks stall. Clink gives WorkBuddy a controlled way to finish them.

blocks.title: From Request Form to Ready-to-Buy.
blocks.body: Describe the need in the same place you assign the task. WorkBuddy turns it into a purchase with the item, the budget line, and the deadline attached.

visual.heading: WorkBuddy request
visual.prompt: The design team needs a replacement drawing tablet under $400 before Thursday's review.

blocks.title: Office Purchases With Approval Rules.
blocks.body: The purchase carries the approval rule with it: the budget owner, the cap, and the purpose. WorkBuddy can only complete what the rule allows.

blocks.title: Receipts Go Where Finance Looks.
blocks.body: The purchase closes with the receipt attached to the request it came from, so finance reviews one thread instead of chasing screenshots.

setup.title: Teach Your Agent to Buy.

howTo.title: Describe the Need. Apply the Rules. File the Receipt.
howTo.description: The approval rule travels with the purchase, which is what keeps office spending reviewable.

steps.name: Describe the Office Need
steps.text: What the team needs, the budget line, and the deadline—stated in the same channel where the task is assigned.

steps.name: Apply the Approval Rules
steps.text: This is the workplace difference: the cap and the budget owner travel with the instruction, so WorkBuddy can only complete purchases the rule allows.

steps.name: File the Receipt Automatically
steps.text: The purchase closes with the receipt attached to the original request, ready for finance review without a follow-up thread.

faqs.q: Who Approves Purchases in a Workplace Setting?
faqs.a: The approval rule does. Each instruction carries the budget owner and the cap, and WorkBuddy can only complete purchases the rule allows—everything else waits for the owner.

faqs.q: Does WorkBuddy Hold Company Card Details?
faqs.a: No. Clink tokenizes the payment credential and releases it per approved purchase. WorkBuddy operates on scope and instructions, never raw card data.
Every purchase resolves to the request, the rule, and the receipt in one thread. Finance reviews the same record the team sees, without a separate reconciliation pass.
